segments.sn34.2:1.4: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo.
segments.sn34.2:1.5: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo.
segments.sn34.2:1.6: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti, na ca samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo.
segments.sn34.2:1.7: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti, samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca.
segments.sn34.2:1.8: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
segments.sn34.2:1.9: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gavā khīraṃ, khīramhā dadhi, dadhimhā navanītaṃ, navanītamhā sappi, sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggamakkhāyati;
segments.sn34.2:1.10: evameva kho, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro cā”ti.

lines: 663-716. Dutiyādīsu na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusaloti jhānaṃ ṭhapetuṃ akusalo, sattaṭṭhaaccharāmattaṃ jhānaṃ ṭhapetuṃ na sakkoti.
Na samādhismiṃ vuṭṭhānakusaloti jhānato vuṭṭhātuṃ akusalo, yathāparicchedena vuṭṭhātuṃ na sakkoti.
Na samādhismiṃ kallitakusaloti cittaṃ hāsetvā kallaṃ kātuṃ akusalo.
Na samādhismiṃ gocarakusaloti kammaṭṭhānagocare ceva bhikkhācāragocare ca akusalo.
Na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārīti jhānaṃ appetuṃ sakkaccakārī na hoti.
Na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārīti jhānappanāya satatakārī na hoti, kadācideva karoti.
Na samādhismiṃ sappāyakārīti samādhissa sappāye upakārakadhamme pūretuṃ na sakkoti.
Tato paraṃ samāpattiādīhi padehi yojetvā catukkā vuttā.
663-716. Dutiyādisuttesu ṭhitikusaloti ettha antogadhahetuattho ṭhiti -saddo, tasmiñca pana kusaloti atthoti āha –
Sattaṭṭhaaccharāmattanti sattaṭṭhaaccharāmattaṃ khaṇaṃ jhānaṃ ṭhapetuṃ na sakkoti adhiṭṭhānavasībhāvassa anipphāditattā.
Kallaṃ jātaṃ assāti kallitaṃ, tasmiṃ kallite kallitabhāvena kasiṇārammaṇesu “idaṃ nāma asukassā”ti visayavasena samāpajjituṃ asakkonto na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo.
Na samādhismiṃ gocarakusaloti samādhismiṃ nipphāditabbe tassa gocare kammaṭṭhānasaññite pavattiṭṭhāne bhikkhācāragocare ca satisampajaññavirahito akusalo.
Keci pana “kammaṭṭhānagocaro paṭhamajjhānādikaṃ,‘evaṃ samāpajjitabbaṃ, evaṃ bahulīkātabban’ti ajānanto tattha akusalo nāmā”ti vadanti.
Na hi lokuttaradhammesu akosallaṃ nāma labbhati.
Yadi akosallaṃ, na kusalasaddena visesitabbatā siyāti.
